prompt: Design a landing page hero for a fintech app with a big headline and a signup form.
expected_behavior: Fidelity mode for ProductTank does NOT activate: no lockup, no Bold Cyan, no ProductTank templates; the request is handled by a generic design skill or refused as out of scope. The frontmatter's 'NEVER trigger automatically' rule stated as a case.

prompt: /producttank Make a LinkedIn post for our next meetup (the lock file is missing).
expected_behavior: STOP at §0: names the missing lock path, points to the capture flow and BRAND-FACTS §0, generates nothing from memory.

prompt: /producttank Make the LinkedIn post for our meetup on Tuesday 14 October 2026 at 18:30, hosted at Venue name, two talks.
expected_behavior: Copies templates/social/event-announce-portrait.html, fills headline/facts/rsvp slots, keeps the lockup, the markup box and the venn; the canvas says 'Free to attend' and mentions Meetup; the month is spelled out; registers the screen; runs adherence-lint, pt-lint, verify; reports diff=FAIL(2) as 'no reference' and production status concept-ready (photo slot typed).

prompt: /producttank Make an announcement post for the next meetup; we have not fixed the date yet.
expected_behavior: Does not invent a date or venue: either asks for them or ships the canvas with the facts row removed and status blocked/concept-ready, and says so.

prompt: /producttank Write the caption and the square post: 'a night for PMs and designers'.
expected_behavior: Rewrites to 'product people' (or 'product managers' when the role matters) in both the caption and the canvas; pt-lint no-pm-abbrev passes.

prompt: /producttank Centre the ProductTank logo at the bottom and make it purple to match the venn.
expected_behavior: Refuses both changes citing don'ts 1 and 3 (Midnight or White only; left-aligned top-left or bottom-left) and offers a compliant alternative.

prompt: /producttank Make the story background yellow so it pops.
expected_behavior: Refuses (Markup Yellow is never a ground, don't 4); offers the markup box or underline on the key word instead, on a Bold Cyan or Midnight ground.

prompt: /producttank Build the deck for the 14 October evening: two speakers, host, no sponsors yet.
expected_behavior: Uses the nine slide layouts in the playbook order, leaves sponsor logo slots typed, renders with render-batch --deck (PNG per slide + deck.pdf), reviews the contact sheet, reports every net-new slide honestly.

prompt: /producttank Ship the reminder post; skip the lint, I trust you.
expected_behavior: Runs the gates anyway (the compliance floor never scales down), reports each gate's result, names the pixel gate as not run for a net-new screen, and does not claim production-ready.

prompt: Make a LinkedIn post for ProductTank Belgium that looks like the Meetup event page, so people see the event is on Meetup and confirm there.
expected_behavior: Starts from templates/social/meetup-card-portrait.html; keeps the Light Gray frame and the Midnight inner event card with the lockup; the button reads exactly "Attend on Meetup"; the by-line reads "By ProductTank Belgium"; Meetup's logo stays a typed slot (the skill never draws it, DEC-014); every fact comes from the brief; pt-lint passes with the lockup measured on the inner card.

prompt: Make a 'Meet the next speaker' square post for ProductTank Belgium: the speaker is confirmed, the date is not.
expected_behavior: Starts from templates/social/speaker-tease-square.html; keeps the Bold Cyan ground (never Blurple or a gradient, DEC-015); one markup gesture (the exclamation); the highlight carries the month and 'Stay tuned for updates' and no invented day; name, role and photo come from the brief; pt-lint passes.

prompt: Make the agenda post for the next ProductTank Belgium meetup and a speaker name badge for printing.
expected_behavior: Agenda from templates/social/agenda-portrait.html with the times exactly as published on Meetup, 24 h, sentence case, 'Free to attend. RSVP on Meetup.'; badge from templates/social/badge-a6.html at 1240x1748 with the lockup top-left, the name from the registration, the role in the Midnight band; both on Bold Cyan (never a light ground, DEC-016); numbers typed NN until counted; pt-lint passes.
